_note: Text traits are the regular expressions in scripts/marketing/traits.py (TEXT_TRAITS) and scripts/launch/build_table.py; they run on a draft with no outcome data. Give them only for posts the launch labeller types as an own announcement; elsewhere they are untested.

tier_1_measured_effect.name: post_type
tier_1_measured_effect.values: launch, open_source, feature, funding, milestone, hiring, other
tier_1_measured_effect.why: launch posts get 2.2x the account's usual and the model predicts 1.03x (launch track)

tier_1_measured_effect.name: media_kind
tier_1_measured_effect.why: video 65.4% against none, grade B, launch track; strongest for model releases (65.3%)

tier_1_measured_effect.name: open_problem
tier_1_measured_effect.why: announcement first 72.5%, grade B, launch track; contradicts the 'pain point first' playbook

tier_1_measured_effect.name: link_in_post
tier_1_measured_effect.why: no link 58.2%, grade B, launch track; agrees with the outside link-penalty studies in direction, not in size

tier_1_measured_effect.name: offer_open_source
tier_1_measured_effect.why: this track: open source / open weights wording, see marketing_evidence.json

tier_1_measured_effect.name: superlative_first
tier_1_measured_effect.why: this track: first / best / most capable claim, see marketing_evidence.json

tier_1_measured_effect.name: offer_credits_discount
tier_1_measured_effect.why: this track: negative, pooled over all accounts (grade C)

tier_1_measured_effect.name: hours_since_previous_own_post
tier_1_measured_effect.why: under 2 h: 0.71x (launch track, C); nothing in the previous 24 h: this track

tier_1_measured_effect.name: own_launch_posts_in_previous_7_days
tier_1_measured_effect.why: this track: a launch that follows another within a week does worse

tier_2_context_not_a_lever.name: ai_model_release
tier_2_context_not_a_lever.why: model releases do 1.2 to 1.5x the account's other launches; a topic the writer does not choose

tier_2_context_not_a_lever.name: account_kind
tier_2_context_not_a_lever.why: feature releases and hiring posts behave differently on company and founder accounts (launch track)

tier_2_context_not_a_lever.name: follower_tier
tier_2_context_not_a_lever.why: video against none is 74.9% under 100k followers and 65.2% above (launch track)

tier_2_context_not_a_lever.name: period
tier_2_context_not_a_lever.why: video and several B findings are weaker after April 2026; the platform changed ranking systems in 2026

tier_3_outside_evidence_only.name: first_hour_quotes_by_other_accounts (count, same-team count, followers of quoters)
tier_3_outside_evidence_only.why: controlled evidence elsewhere that early support compounds (R:C07, R:C08); here 69.2% and a dose-response, but circular. Useful as a post-launch signal, never as advice

tier_3_outside_evidence_only.name: video_duration_seconds
tier_3_outside_evidence_only.why: playbooks and the code's 10-second threshold; empty in this corpus, to be filled by the media track

tier_3_outside_evidence_only.name: image_content (benchmark chart, product screenshot, face)
tier_3_outside_evidence_only.why: Li and Xie 2020 on faces; AI playbooks on benchmark charts; text proxy showed nothing (H14)

tier_3_outside_evidence_only.name: link_in_first_reply
tier_3_outside_evidence_only.why: platform statements in both directions; replies not collected

tier_3_outside_evidence_only.name: engagement_bait_request
tier_3_outside_evidence_only.why: X's code and 2026 statements penalise it; 10 launch posts here

do_not_add: posting hour or weekday in Pacific time (no effect in any of seven comparisons)
call to action to try the product
you / your in the first line
